modules.title: 8 operational modules, plus AI Copilot (planned)

items.title: Business Analysis Module
items.desc: Shows the real net revenue and profit generated by each project. Visualizes top-performing client projects, category margins, and financial health in real time.

items.title: Hub دفتر Overview Module
items.desc: A birds-eye view of your entire agency's momentum. See live task completion, active projects, employee statuses, and department progress at a single glance.

items.title: Attendance & Leave Module
items.desc: 1-click daily check-in. Tracks attendance, casual/sick leaves, WFH requests, office working hours, late arrivals, and early exits with an immutable audit log.

items.title: Projects Module
items.desc: Organizes all client projects category-wise (e.g. Mobile, Web, AI, Retainers). Track milestone deadlines, deliverables, sprints, and subtasks cleanly.

items.title: Password Manager Module
items.desc: Secure client credentials in an AES-256 encrypted vault instead of Google Sheets or WhatsApp. Grant access strictly to specific individuals with copy/reveal logs.

items.title: Time Tracking Module
items.desc: Developers track billable time via an active timer or manual log entry. Visualize exactly who worked the most on each client task without weekly timesheet friction.

items.title: Workload & Capacity Module
items.desc: Inspect live developer capacity before delegating work. Instantly see who has maximum tasks/projects allocated and who has available bandwidth, preventing burnout and blown deadlines.

items.title: Employee Management Module
items.desc: Centralized team directory and people operations. Manage employee profiles, job titles, departmental rosters, and access permissions in one unified dashboard.

ai.title: AI Copilot Module
ai.desc: An assistant that watches your operations so you don't have to. When released, it will be included in your plan with no extra subscription fee — your agency simply connects its own AI API key. It recommends which team member each new task should be assigned to based on live workload and skills, flags projects trending toward a loss, and summarizes where the week's time actually went.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Direct answers to the questions agency owners ask us most.

items.a: Hub دفتر is an agency operations platform for digital agencies and service providers. It replaces disconnected tools with one unified system covering attendance, leaves, projects, client passwords, time tracking, workload, and project profitability. Every plan includes eight working core modules plus three custom modules built for your agency.

items.q: Who is Hub دفتر designed for?
items.a: Small digital agencies, software development agencies, web and mobile development teams, AI and digital service providers, and any service business that wants structured office and team management. It is built specifically for agencies, not as a generic task manager.

Eight core modules are available today: Business Analysis, Hub دفتر Overview, Attendance & Leave, Projects, Password Manager, Time Tracking, Workload & Capacity, and Employee Management. All eight are included in every plan. AI Copilot is a planned additional module currently in development.

items.q: What are the three custom modules?
items.a: They are three additional modules built specifically for your agency — not three selected from the existing eight. They are designed around your office workflows and operational processes, based on a discovery meeting where we learn how your team works and where time is being spent.

items.q: Does every paying customer receive the three custom modules?
items.a: Yes. Every paying customer receives all eight core modules plus three custom modules built for their agency, included in the plan price. There is no separate charge for the three custom modules.

items.q: How are the custom modules selected?
items.a: After a discovery meeting. We learn your agency's workflow and how time is spent on your existing processes, then you and the Hub دفتر team decide together which three modules will make your operations more systematic.

items.q: When will the custom modules be delivered?
items.a: During your first month. Your first week is reserved for onboarding; the three custom modules are agreed with you and delivered across the first month.

items.q: Are small future changes and maintenance included?
items.a: Yes. Small changes up to 4 hours of work are free. Larger work and additional modules are quoted in development hours before work starts. Attendance or vault outages are resolved the same day; all other customer-reported issues within 2 working days.

items.q: How are additional new modules charged?
items.a: The initial three custom modules are included for every paying customer. Small changes up to 4 hours of work are free. Larger work and additional modules are quoted in development hours before work starts.
No. AI Copilot is a planned module currently in development. When released, it will be included in your plan with no extra subscription fee — your agency simply connects its own AI API key.

items.q: Are AI API usage costs included in the subscription?
items.a: There is no extra subscription fee for AI Copilot. Your agency connects its own AI API key and pays only for what it uses directly with the AI provider.

Every plan (Starter, Team Plan, Growth) includes all eight core modules, three custom modules built for your workflow, first-week onboarding, ongoing support, free small changes up to 4 hours of work, and same-day attendance/vault resolution (2 working days for other issues). The plans differ only by seat limit (10, 15, or 25 seats), not by features.

Every employee onboarded into your workspace counts as one user. A 10-seat Starter Plan lets you onboard 10 people; a 15-seat Team Plan lets you onboard 15 people. Within your plan's seat limit there is no separate per-seat charge — that is what "no seat penalties" means here.

items.q: Can employee job titles be customized?
items.a: Yes. Employee job titles are customizable — Developer, Designer, QA Engineer, Tech Lead, Project Manager, HR Manager, or any title your agency uses. If you need additional role or workflow customization, share your requirements and the Hub دفتر team will customize the setup for you.

items.q: What happens during the first-week onboarding?
items.a: The first week is dedicated to onboarding. We explain the features, help your team understand how the software works, handle migration and integrations, and get everyone comfortable using the system. Your three custom modules are delivered during the first month, not the first week.

items.q: What support is available after onboarding?
items.a: Ongoing support is included. Small changes up to 4 hours of work are free. Larger work and additional modules are quoted in development hours before work starts. Attendance or vault outages are resolved the same day; all other customer-reported issues within 2 working days. You also receive role-specific handbooks for Admin, HR, Employee, Project Manager, and Team Lead.

items.q: What happens to our agency data when we leave?
items.a: When you leave, we export your agency's data upon request so you keep access to it, then permanently delete everything associated with your agency from our systems — projects, teams, employees, logs, and database records.

items.q: How is our data isolated and secured?
items.a: Your agency receives a dedicated database instance and app deployment. Client passwords are stored in an AES-256 encrypted vault with an audit log recording who viewed or copied credentials and when. Developer salary rates and project margin charts are role-gated and accessible only to designated administrators.
